name: Disease
body:
Disease
Source Horror Realms pg. 19
One of the eidolon’s natural weapons carries a disease chosen from the following list: bubonic plague, filth fever, leprosy, red ache, or shakes. Each hit forces a saving throw against the disease’s normal effects. The disease has no onset, however. The save DC equals 10 + 1/2 the eidolon’s Hit Dice + the eidolon’s Constitution modifier. The eidolon can expose a creature to its disease no more than once per round. By spending 2 additional evolution points, you can instead choose the following additional diseases: demon fever (only if the eidolon has the demon subtype), devil chills (only if the eidolon has the devil subtype), or slimy doom. Requirements: Aberrant, daemon, demon, or devil subtype or the undead appearance evolutionUM; summoner level 7th.
